_comment: Describes the demo corpus for build_corpus.py. Four records: three local clips of the same speech by different speakers (Mode A) plus the YouTube original (Mode B), so both player paths are exercised from one data file. Run: python3 operations/scripts/build_corpus.py --manifest inputs/corpus.manifest.json

videos.title: Just Do It — Madeleine Woods (local clip)
videos._note: This .srt was generated from madeleine.json with millisecond precision (operations/scripts/diarize_to_srt.py). To ingest the diarized JSON directly instead, replace the "srt" line with: "diarize_json": "madeleine.json" — both produce identical timestamps and speaker labels.
